items.title: Ben Kelly Interview, 1960-08-11
items.q: Heisenborns, Peter Anderson, and well, see Sonny Henry, he was in my class.

ctx.x: And he was a fairly good reader, would you say?

He was a number one reader. He was. Really good. He was really good. You could get any piece of music you could put up there. He would look at it and cast his eye down on it. That was all right. He got it, son. Yeah. Yeah. But give him that. Who was him? Heisenborns, Peter Anderson, and well, see Sonny Henry, he was in my class. He was in there.
And he could really get it. Who was Chris' teacher? Did he have a teacher then too? Professor Umpham. He was, taught him too?
